zh-Hans: 这里只显示审核通过的商家。

en: Try another tag. Only approved merchants are shown.
zh-Hans: 换个标签看看。这里只显示审核通过的商家。

en: This merchant’s public home is unavailable.
zh-Hans: 该商家的公开主页暂不可用。

en: Scan or enter the city-node code presented by the player, then review before redeeming.
zh-Hans: 扫描或手动输入玩家出示的据点码，确认后再核销。

en: Live city-node redemption is not enabled. This code will not be sent.
zh-Hans: 据点实际核销尚未启用，不会发送此码。

en: The camera opens only after you choose Scan and allow camera access. A scan does not redeem automatically.
zh-Hans: 仅在你选择扫描并允许相机访问后开启相机，扫码不会自动核销。

en: This sends the player’s code for redemption and may issue the player a coupon. The server checks merchant permission, check-in and stock.
zh-Hans: 此操作将发送玩家的据点码进行核销，并可能向玩家发券。服务器会校验商家权限、到店打卡和库存。

en: Enter a nonempty code of at most 16 KB.
zh-Hans: 请输入有效的非空据点码，长度不超过 16 KB。

en: A previous redemption still needs verification, or its local record cannot be read. Further redemption is blocked.
zh-Hans: 此前核销仍需核对，或本地记录无法读取，已阻止继续核销。

en: Your session or merchant changed. Open this page again to review a code.
zh-Hans: 登录状态或商家已变更，请重新打开此页面后确认。

en: The redemption outcome is unknown. Do not rescan or redeem another code until the previous outcome is verified.
zh-Hans: 核销结果尚不确定。在核对此前结果前，请勿重扫或核销其他码。

en: Your current merchant permission does not allow redemption.
zh-Hans: 当前商家权限不允许核销。

en: Merchant permission could not be checked. No redemption was sent.
zh-Hans: 暂时无法核对商家权限，尚未发送核销请求。
